Legal information

House rules

Translation for information only. The Czech version is legally binding.

  1. Only people named in the booking who show ID on arrival may stay. Guests pay the local tourist tax under the municipal bylaw.
  2. Check-in from 15:00, check-out by 10:00. On departure the guest hands the complex over to the host's representative.
  3. Quiet hours: after 22:00 noise must be kept down; from midnight complete silence applies, meaning music and all sources of noise switched off.
  4. Smoking and open flames are prohibited in all indoor areas. Fires are allowed only in the fire pit.
  5. Pets only if notified in advance. Free when renting the whole property; in the apartments in summer, a fee per the price list in the booking. Animals are not allowed on beds, in the wellness area or in the pool.
  6. The pool is not fenced. It has a sliding cover, which we recommend keeping closed whenever nobody is swimming so that no small child or animal can fall in. When the cover is open, an adult must supervise the pool at all times.
  7. Saunas, infrared sauna, hot tub and pool must be used according to the instructions at each facility. Showering is required before using the hot tub or pool. People under the influence of alcohol may not use the wellness facilities.
  8. Hot tub in the stage: when used as a stage, the hot tub must be covered as instructed by the host.
  9. The terrace curtains must be raised in strong wind. Site equipment (filtration, water heating) must not be switched off.
  10. Camping and caravan parking are prohibited around the complex. Park vehicles only in designated spaces.
  11. Fishing in the reservoir is allowed only with a valid fishing licence and permit.
  12. The outdoor areas are monitored by a camera system to protect property and guest safety. Recordings are reviewed only if a problem occurs.
  13. On departure the guest returns equipment (crockery, sports gear, grilling tools) to its original place.
  14. In the event of a serious breach of the rules the host may end the stay without refund.
